parameters.query:
-- First transition: ingress may not have recorded FORWARDED yet (it does so
-- after our 202), so RECEIVED is accepted too (contracts.md Amendment 2).
WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'LOGGED_ONLY', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status IN ('RECEIVED', 'FORWARDED')
  RETURNING conversation_id
), dec AS (
  INSERT INTO hotline.decisions AS d (conversation_id, route, decided_at)
  SELECT conversation_id, 'LOGGED_ONLY', now() FROM moved
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE
     SET route = 'LOGGED_ONLY', decided_at = EXCLUDED.decided_at
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS conversation_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM moved) AS status_moved;

UPDATE hotline.call_events
   SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = left($2, 1000), updated_at = now()
 WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status IN ('RECEIVED', 'FORWARDED')
RETURNING conversation_id;

parameters.query:
WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'LOGGED_ONLY', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = 'EXTRACTED'
  RETURNING conversation_id
), dec AS (
  INSERT INTO hotline.decisions AS d (conversation_id, route, intent_score, decided_at)
  SELECT conversation_id, 'LOGGED_ONLY', $2, now() FROM moved
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE
     SET route = 'LOGGED_ONLY', intent_score = EXCLUDED.intent_score, decided_at = EXCLUDED.decided_at
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS conversation_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM moved) AS status_moved;

WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = 'EXTRACTED'
  RETURNING conversation_id
), dec AS (
  INSERT INTO hotline.decisions AS d (conversation_id, route, intent_score)
  SELECT conversation_id, 'APPROVAL', $2 FROM moved
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE
     SET route = 'APPROVAL', intent_score = EXCLUDED.intent_score,
         approval_outcome = NULL, approver = NULL, decided_at = NULL
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
SELECT conversation_id FROM moved;

parameters.query:
WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'REJECTED', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
UPDATE hotline.decisions d SET approval_outcome = 'REJECTED', approver = $2, decided_at = now()
  FROM moved WHERE d.conversation_id = moved.conversation_id
RETURNING d.conversation_id;

WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
UPDATE hotline.decisions d SET approval_outcome = 'EXPIRED', decided_at = now()
  FROM moved WHERE d.conversation_id = moved.conversation_id
RETURNING d.conversation_id;

parameters.query:
-- Decision upsert first (replay-safe), then the guarded status move.
WITH dec AS (
  INSERT INTO hotline.decisions AS d
    (conversation_id, route, intent_score, approval_outcome, approver, decided_at, sf_lead_id, sf_task_id)
  VALUES ($1, $3, $4, $5, $6, now(), $7, $8)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET
    route            = EXCLUDED.route,
    intent_score     = EXCLUDED.intent_score,
    approval_outcome = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.approval_outcome, d.approval_outcome),
    approver         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.approver, d.approver),
    decided_at       = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.route = 'APPROVAL' THEN COALESCE(d.decided_at, EXCLUDED.decided_at)
                            ELSE EXCLUDED.decided_at END,
    sf_lead_id       = EXCLUDED.sf_lead_id,
    sf_task_id       = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sf_task_id, d.sf_task_id)
  RETURNING conversation_id
), moved AS (
  UPDATE hotline.call_events SET status = 'WRITTEN', updated_at = now()
   WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = $2
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS conversation_id, $3::text AS route, $7::text AS sf_lead_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dec) AS decision_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM moved) AS status_moved;
